newsitem.title: USA: Dwyer Group units sell Saudi Arabia master license.
newsitem.headline: Dwyer Group units sell Saudi Arabia master license.

text.p: The Dwyer Group Inc said three of its franchising companies have sold a master license in Saudi Arabia, marking the company's entry into the Middle East market.
The speciality services company provided no details on the deal by its Mr. Electric, Mr. Rooter and Aire Serv units. Officials from the Dwyer Group were not immediately available to comment.
Robert Tunmire, Dwyer's President and CEO, said in a release that the transaction was part of the company's overall international expansion strategy and that it now has master licenses in 20 markets.
